get_2d_sincos_pos_embed: create 2D sine-cosine position embeddings for a given grid size and embedding dimension
get_1d_sincos_pos_embed_from_grid: create 1D sine-cosine position embeddings from a list of positions and embedding dimension
interpolate_pos_embed: interpolate checkpoint position embeddings to match a model with a different patch size using bicubic interpolation
RoPE2D_forward: apply 2D rotary position embeddings to transformer tokens given their y and x positions
RoPE2D_rotate_half: rotate the last dimension of a tensor by splitting it in half and negating the second half
